verdict.rationale: Letta clearly supports local-first operation for its default mode ('stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login') and offers a self-hosted App Server that runs 'entirely on infrastructure you control,' which covers embedded/local persistence and deployment. However, the evidence never shows the memory layer working against local model backends (e.g., local LLM inference) without any cloud dependency — docs instead reference 'existing API keys and coding plans' and cloud sandboxes, and shared memory is explicitly described as 'hosted in Letta Cloud,' undercutting a fully cloud-free claim for some memory features. missing for 10: explicit support for local model inference (no cloud LLM calls), confirmation that all memory features (not just default local storage) work without any cloud dependency.
